content_of_post_to_comment: Some contend that the “slippery slope fallacy” is no fallacy at all. Big mistake. If we remove the slippery slope fallacy from the list of logical fallacies, then before we know it we’ll find ourselves removing all the other informal fallacies from the list — and will soon forget the very concept of an informal fallacy altogether.
comment: The irony is that slippery slope arguments can themselves become slippery slopes: rejecting one may be rational, but rejecting all requires a separate argument about standards of reasoning.
